description: Send a direct message to ONE member of a Slack workspace, as the Hermoso app (it arrives in their Apps section, from Hermoso). It reaches a real person at once: show the user the exact text and who it goes to first. `member` is a member id from list_slack_members, or an @name or full name; two people with the same name are listed for you to choose, never guessed between. Up to 4,000 characters; a longer message is refused, not split. Needs the Hermoso app in the Slack workspace with its direct-message permissions: a workspace that added the app before 2026-11-15 adds it again once under Connectors > Slack (the tool says so). Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

slackWorkspace.description: which workspace (id or name) when there are several

name: send_slack_dm
title: Send a Slack direct message
